messages.text: you guy ship from canada ?

Yes, we ship to Canada, and the Magic Miner 40T goes out from our US/Canada side, so no import VAT or duty on a Canadian address. Sales tax gets added at checkout if it applies, and shipping is calculated there too.

Quick note on timing: the 40T is a Batch 5 pre-sale, $799, ships November 14.

Where in Canada are you? I'll run the numbers at your power rate.
Edmonton
Ran the power-cost calculator

Ran these for (address hidden), at a generic $0.17/kWh since I don't have your real rate. Tell me what you pay per kWh and I'll redo it.

Magic Miner 40T, $799: about 57,400 sats a month, worth roughly $47.58 today. Power runs about $80.62/month at 650 W, so at today's BTC price you're stacking sats, not netting cash. Break-even BTC is around $140,400. Solo block shot is about 1 in 165,000 a day, 0.22% over a year.

The B30 ($899, 405 W) uses less power, break-even around $116,700. Cheaper to run, less hashrate.
im at .08 cent per kilowatts
Ran the power-cost calculator · 8¢/kWh

At 8 cents in (address hidden), both are in the black today.

Magic Miner 40T, $799: about 57,400 sats a month, worth $47.58 today. Power is $37.94/month, so roughly $9.65 net. Break-even BTC $66,079. Solo block odds about 1 in 165,000 a day, 0.22% over a year.

Harlo B30, $899: about 43,100 sats a month ($35.69), power $23.64, net about $12.05. Break-even $54,897.

The 40T hashes more and hunts the block harder. The B30 is easier on the meter. Today's estimate, not a promise.
